0.5.1-beta / versionCode18 — hold original-template comparison
Date: 2026-10-17

Delivery
  APK: nikon-usb-0.5.1-beta-debug.apk
  Size: 2708089 bytes
  SHA-256: 01941168d2b2e40f0aa9900fc93dab2fe19c8577fdb1dd86eb3560904becb015
  scripts/build-apk.ps1 completed; v2/v3 APK signatures verified.

Change
  Downloaded-preset detail main image has a bottom-end 48dp compare control, inset12dp.
  DOWN shows the unapplied current template; UP restores the preset simulation.
  Original/effect share the same CENTER_CROP and dimensions, with truthful state badge.
  Both bitmaps preload off-thread and remain referenced by the control. Version+epoch
  checks reject stale template/page callbacks. Comparison is enabled only when ready.
  Slide-out, cancel, additional pointers, focus loss, pause and detach restore effect.
  Moving back inside an already cancelled gesture does not re-enter original mode.
  Keyboard/accessibility click uses a separate toggle; touch does not double-toggle.
  Detail's external original-dialog link is removed; Settings original viewer remains.

Validation
  Pixel9 Android17/API37 temporary read-only emulator, 1080x2424 portrait.
  Imported hand-written PreviewTone.NCP through Android's document picker.
  15 functional assertions passed: ready-effect, DOWN, UP, image-region change and
  exact restoration, secondDOWN, slideout, no-reentry, preCANCEL-DOWN, CANCEL,
  prePAUSE-DOWN, HOME/resume, keyboard original, keyboard effect, dark+font1.3,
  restored emulator settings. Evidence: docs/device-review/compare-0.5.1-gesture.log.
  Original and effect visibly differ, without crop or layout movement. ROI(120,470,
  480,400) PNG hash differs on DOWN and matches the initial effect exactly on UP.
  Dark theme/fontScale1.3 control label fits; test emulator restored light/font1.0.
  Multi-pointer release, loading failure, stale callback and detach were inspected
  in source, not injected as physical multi-touch tests. Independent source review
  found no confirmed P1/P2 in the helper and MainActivity integration.
  Native UI patch compiled; no full core/probe suite rerun. Older8212/3487 counts
  remain 0.5 evidence, not new checks for this release. git diff --check passed.

Review
  Fresh independent native finish reviewer: disposition ship, no material fixes.
  Required files .impeccable/review/phone-apple-v051-{effect,held-original,
  released-effect,dark-large-effect}.png were opened and validated by root/reviewer.
  Exact scoped record: docs/design-review/apple-glass/finish-review-0.5.1.md.
  No HTML/CSS detector for native Views. Scope is the captured emulator phone UI.

Phone installation
  OnePlus PKG110 Android16 serial286f0dba owner0: install-r succeeded, code18/name0.5.1.

Limits

  No new real-camera, camera-effect equivalence, tablet or physical-gesture claims.
